title: Light-diffusing systems.
officialText:
Light-diffusing systems shall comply with Sections 2603.7.1 through 2603.7.5. Light-diffusing
systems shall not be installed in the following occupancies and locations:
1. Any room in which the net floor area per occupant is 20 square feet (1.86 m2) or less, or any room leading therefrom through
which it is necessary for occupants to pass in order to reach the only exit.
2. Group I-2.
3. Group I-3.
4. Vertical exit enclosures and exit passageways.
